name: Pierce Villiers
source:
An insomniac field mouse who drinks too much coffee.
He likes Nightmare, The March Hare and the White Rabbit.
He hates Cheshire Cat, The Mad Hatter, and the Queen of Hearts.
He used to be part of the Mad Hatters group, but he ran away when the Hatter started plotting with the Cat and the Tweedles started bullying him.
